dct_title_s: GAR15 Global Exposure Dataset for Hong Kong
dct_description_sm: The GAR15 global exposure database is based on a top-down approach where statistical information including socio-economic, building type, and capital stock at a national level are transposed onto the grids of 5x5 or 1x1 using geographic distribution of population data and gross domestic product (GDP) as proxies.
dct_spatial_sm: China, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
